title: hemionitis goyazensis
intro: Hemionitis goyazensis, commonly known as Goyaz fern or Goyaz's hemionitis, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine in Brazil and has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Hemionitis goyazensis include its ability to act as an antiseptic, antimicrobial, and anti-ulcerogenic agent, making it useful for wound healing and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
